record.name: Apify
record.one_liner: Cloud platform and marketplace for web scraping, browser automation, and AI tools with a REST API and official MCP server.
record.access_note: Sign up on the Apify console to get a free plan with monthly credits and an API token.
record.api_note: The REST API covers Actors, runs, builds, tasks, datasets, key-value stores, request queues, schedules, webhooks, and account settings.

evidence.quote: (Recommended) Add the token to your request's Authorization header as Bearer
Free $0 $5 to spend in Apify Store or on your own Actors
Apify API documentation: Endpoints to manage Actors, runs, builds, tasks, datasets, key-value stores, request queues, schedules, webhooks, and your account.
The Apify's MCP server (mcp.apify.com) allows AI applications and agents to interact with the Apify platform
